name: Deep Dive Review

template.name: Deep Dive Review
template.description: A hands-on template for reviewers who actually use the app: three steps — play the user, play the sceptic, play the witness — with 9 questions that demand evidence, punish rushing and end in one honest sentence.

notes: Every attention check here is a trap the reviewer can only pass by reading: one multiple choice where more than one option must be ticked, one that makes them write a phrase in their own words, and one that asks them to count the flow they are in.

attention_check_conventions.single_choice: attention_check_answer is the exact option string that must be selected.
attention_check_conventions.multiple_choice: attention_check_answer is the full list of options that must be ticked, and nothing else.
attention_check_conventions.long_text: attention_check_answer is {"mode":"contains","phrase":"...","case_sensitive":false} — the written answer must contain that phrase and still meet min_words.

questions.prompt: What was the very first thing the app let you do without creating an account?
questions.hint: Think about the first screen you landed on and what it allowed before any sign-up.
options: I could browse or try the main feature
I could look, but every action asked me to sign up
Nothing — it demanded an account before showing anything
It showed an advert or an offer instead of the app

questions.prompt: Give the app a real job to do — a search, a name, a small action it is built for. Then describe the exact steps you took and what came back.
questions.hint: At least 20 words. Say what you tapped, what you typed in, and exactly what the app returned.

questions.prompt: Attention check: tick every word in this list that is a colour.
questions.hint: More than one answer is correct. Tick only the colours.

questions.prompt: Did anything in the app try to rush you? Countdowns, “only 3 slots left”, “offer ends today”, that kind of thing.
questions.hint: Include push notifications, pop-ups and anything that made you feel late.
options: Once or twice, and it felt harmless
Constantly — the app kept nudging me
It blocked me until I agreed to something

questions.prompt: Follow the money: if you had paid in this app, where would your naira actually have gone?
questions.hint: Tick everything you saw. Only report a route you could actually see in the app.
options: Store subscription billed by Play Store or App Store
In-app purchase handled by the store
Bank transfer to a company account
Nowhere — the app never asked me for money

questions.prompt: Attention check: write the sentence “I checked it myself” in the box, then use one more sentence to say what you actually tested in this app.
questions.hint: At least 8 words in total. Copy the sentence exactly, then answer in your own words.

questions.prompt: If our trust team opened this app tomorrow, what is the first thing they would notice?
questions.hint: Be blunt. Base it on what you saw, not on what the store page says.

questions.prompt: Write the one sentence you would tell a friend about this app if you met them in a queue.
questions.hint: At least 12 words. Praise or warning — just make it honest and specific.

questions.prompt: Attention check: this review has three steps and you are on the third. Select “3” below.
questions.hint: Read the question again before answering.
